name: BWX Technologies, Inc.

investment_theses.company_type: Nuclear Components / SMR Development / Naval Propulsion

content: BWX Technologies, Inc. is a leading supplier of nuclear components and fuel to the U.S. government, providing technical and manufacturing services to support the nation's nuclear fleet and national security programs. The company specializes in the design and manufacture of precision nuclear components, including reactor cores and steam generators, for the U.S. Navy's nuclear-powered submarines and aircraft carriers. Additionally, BWXT is a pioneer in the development of small modular reactors (SMRs) and advanced nuclear technologies for commercial power generation and space exploration, while also providing specialized nuclear medicine and environmental restoration services.

Officers

Rex D. Geveden(Date: 2017 January)

President and Chief Executive Officer

Mr. Geveden has served as President and Chief Executive Officer of BWXT since 2017. He joined the company in 2015 as Chief Operating Officer. Previously, he was Executive Vice President at Teledyne Technologies Incorporated.

Robb A. LeMasters(Date: 2021 November)

Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer

Mr. LeMasters has served as Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer since 2021. He previously served as Senior Vice President, Strategy and Corporate Development from 2020 to 2021 and was a member of the Board of Directors from 2015 to 2020.

Kevin M. McCoy(Date: 2022 March)

President, BWXT Government Operations

Vice Admiral McCoy (Ret.) has served as President of BWXT Government Operations since 2022. He previously served as President of Irving Shipbuilding Inc. and had a 36-year career in the U.S. Navy.

John R. MacQuarrie(Date: 2022 March)

President, BWXT Commercial Operations

Mr. MacQuarrie has served as President of BWXT Commercial Operations since 2022. He previously served as President of BWXT Canada Ltd. since 2013.

Directors

John A. Fees(Date: 2010 July)

Chairman of the Board

Mr. Fees has served as the non-executive Chairman of the Board since 2010. He was previously the Chief Executive Officer of McDermott International, Inc.

Jan A. Bertsch(Date: 2013 January)

Independent Director

Ms. Bertsch served as Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Owens-Illinois, Inc. from 2015 to 2019.

Gerhard F. Burbach(Date: 2018 January)

Independent Director

Mr. Burbach served as President, Chief Executive Officer and Director of Thoratec Corporation from 2006 to 2014.

Barbara A. Niland(Date: 2016 January)

Independent Director

Ms. Niland served as Corporate Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Huntington Ingalls Industries, Inc. from 2011 to 2016.

Robert L. Nardelli(Date: 2015 January)

Independent Director

Mr. Nardelli is the founder of XLR-8, LLC and previously served as Chairman and CEO of Chrysler LLC and The Home Depot, Inc.
